blind.description: A free-standing masonry archway or doorway constructed from weathered, mossy stone blocks. It features two rectangular pillars supporting a pointed Gothic arch within a rectangular wall segment, topped with a flat stone capping slab made of three block segments. The stonework is textured with greenish-grey and brownish stone bricks with engraved mortar lines. All surfaces are solid, cleanly defined, and completely continuous with no floating, melted, or shard-like geometry. It stands directly on its two pillar bases flat on the ground with no separate plinth or baseplate.
blind.from_above: From directly above, it appears as a narrow horizontal rectangular stone cap divided into three rounded-edge stone slabs.
blind.height_vs_figure: It stands about 7 to 8 feet tall (roughly 1.3 times the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure) and about 5 feet wide, with a doorway opening roughly 5.5 to 6 feet tall.
